items.description: Tokens, materials, motion and base styles, plus the theme provider (d toggles dark mode).

theme.shadow-stone:
inset 0 1px 0 var(--highlight), inset 0 -2px 0 var(--edge),
    0 1px 2px var(--drop), 0 2px 6px -3px var(--drop)
theme.shadow-key:
inset 0 1px 0 var(--highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--edge),
    0 3px 0 var(--lip, var(--edge)), 0 5px 10px -4px var(--drop)

@utility gloss-sheen.--gloss-reflection:
linear-gradient(
    115deg,
    transparent 14%,
    color-mix(
        in oklch,
        var(--sheen) calc(50% * var(--gloss-strength, 1)),
        transparent
      )
      25%,
    color-mix(
        in oklch,
        var(--sheen) calc(12% * var(--gloss-strength, 1)),
        transparent
      )
      37%,
    transparent 42%
  )

@utility gloss.background-image:
var(--gloss-streak, var(--gloss-reflection)),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, var(--shade) 90%, var(--bounce))
